title: Connect resource links on the Resources page

requirements.text: In the Resources page (`frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx`), connect the following four downloadable/external resource items to their respective URLs, opening each link in a new tab. The items and their URLs are: (1) वैदिक दर्शन का परिचय → https://share.google/ofFQSRZ1FTsdJB8Op; (2) दैनिक प्रार्थना संग्रह → https://adipurgroup.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/e0a4b8e0a4ade0a4be.pdf; (3) त्योहार कैलेंडर और अनुष्ठान → https://calendarhindu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Hindu-Calendar-2026-With-Tithi-in-Hindi-PDF-Download.pdf; (4) भगवद गीता अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका → https://www.rupanugabhajanashram.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Bhagavad-Gita-Hindi.pdf. Each link must use `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

quotes: connect links in विशेष संसाधन page वैदिक दर्शन का परिचय https://share.google/ofFQSRZ1FTsdJB8Op , दैनिक प्रार्थना संग्रह - https://adipurgroup.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/e0a4b8e0a4ade0a4be.pdf , त्योहार कैलेंडर और अनुष्ठान - https://calendarhindu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Hindu-Calendar-2026-With-Tithi-in-Hindi-PDF-Download.pdf , भगवद गीता अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका - https://www.rupanugabhajanashram.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Bhagavad-Gita-Hindi.pdf

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the वैदिक दर्शन का परिचय item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://share.google/ofFQSRZ1FTsdJB8Op in a new tab.
Clicking the दैनिक प्रार्थना संग्रह item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://adipurgroup.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/e0a4b8e0a4ade0a4be.pdf in a new tab.

Clicking the त्योहार कैलेंडर और अनुष्ठान item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://calendarhindu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Hindu-Calendar-2026-With-Tithi-in-Hindi-PDF-Download.pdf in a new tab.
Clicking the भगवद गीता अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका item/button on the Resources page navigates to https://www.rupanugabhajanashram.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Bhagavad-Gita-Hindi.pdf in a new tab.
All four links include target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" attributes.

constraints: Do not change any other content or layout on the Resources page beyond adding the href links.
Do not modify any file listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Adding new resource items or categories not mentioned by the user.
Translating any additional text on the Resources page.
